scope.claim_boundary: No inference from RH, zeta spectra, random-matrix fits, or criticality to biological implementation, intelligence, or consciousness without a separately replicated causal mechanism.
scope.rh_status_snapshot: As of 2026-11-25, Clay lists RH as Active; a large Lean formalization is under public machine and human review, with no readable peer-reviewed proof.

hypotheses.statement: Zeta-derived features have no special predictive advantage over matched generic spectral bases.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: No special advantage is established; use equivalence bounds and matched controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: A robust held-out zeta-specific gain beyond every matched basis and shuffle control.

hypotheses.statement: Spectral descriptors of model dynamics predict transfer, robustness, or memory.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Incremental held-out prediction across seeds and families.
hypotheses.falsifier: Signal disappears under matched random-matrix controls or held-out families.

hypotheses.statement: Near-critical dynamics improve some computational trade-offs.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Replicated regime-dependent Pareto improvement with stability costs reported.
hypotheses.falsifier: No replicable benefit or benefits vary by task and finite size.

hypotheses.statement: Both tails of learned singular spectra can carry task-relevant information.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Tail interventions impair performance beyond matched bulk and random interventions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Tail effects vanish under norm/rank/conditioning-matched controls.

hypotheses.statement: Koopman/operator features improve multi-step and intervention prediction.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Held-out prediction or intervention fidelity improves at matched compute.
hypotheses.falsifier: Gain disappears under capacity, compute, or regime-shift controls.

hypotheses.statement: Prime/logarithmic or zeta-ordinate bases help prime-structured tasks.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Held-out arithmetic-range gains beat Fourier, wavelet, random, and shuffled controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: No advantage over matched bases or no transfer outside discovery ranges.

hypotheses.statement: Spectral-mode interventions have causal explanatory value.
hypotheses.positive_evidence: Predicted perturbation effect and matched restoration replicate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Descriptors correlate but interventions do not validate the proposed mechanism.
